name: Control Room
description: One panel for what waits on you and where each piece of work stands: bot items, gates, Runs, tasks, workers and agents. Read only.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Control Room: what waits on you

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Full path to the orca CLI (on Windows, orca.exe; a .cmd file is skipped). Leave empty: Control Room finds it next to Orca, in the default install folder, or on PATH.

settings.title: Notify new waits
settings.description: Show one desktop notification when something new waits on you. Each wait notifies once.
